# TITMAS canonical machine discovery pointer

Canonical agent entry: ./agent-index.json
Human-compatible entry: ./TITMAS/README.md
Conformance command: python3 TITMAS/conformance/harness.py

TITMAS is commercial, private-core infrastructure for Agent action control and
execution evidence. Public Schema, SDK, MCP, examples and validators are bounded
interoperability surfaces; they do not imply an open-source core, public
contribution route or developer community. TITMAS is not an Agent Runtime,
executor, certification authority, truth store or autonomous GitHub authority.

Verified foundation evidence includes a PostgreSQL deployment and tenant-safe
operational metrics. CR-01 backup integrity and structural restoration passed,
but 2 of 1,661 restored historical synthetic Receipt signatures could not be
verified because their random key was never retained. Full restore therefore
failed, RTO is not established, and CR-01 is
BLOCKED_LEDGER_INTEGRITY. The records were not deleted, rewritten, re-signed,
or allowlisted. Agent end-to-end, security-suite, external-agent-beta and
seven-day soak gates remain false. No payment processor or active pricing is
connected.

Human Decision CR01-D02 is accepted for design only. Three role-scoped
qwen3.7-max reviews recommend an immutable signed exception manifest plus a
Tenant-scoped clean Receipt epoch anchored to the corresponding legacy chain
tip. The legacy result remains 1,659 valid and 2 unverifiable; the anchor does
not validate the missing signatures. Gateway implementation, database
migration, a second deployment retry, CR-01 restart and soak remain
unauthorized. The next decision is
CR01-D03_OPTION_C_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_CAP_EXCEPTION.

Stage 5.8 records 24 candidate outcomes: 22 valid and 2 retained unknowns. The
replacement threshold passed 4 of 6 criteria, so the conclusion remains
NOT_ASSESSED and the comparison limitation is retained. It is not customer
adoption or production evidence.
